title: Consolidation: From the Historical Constitution to Constitutional Review

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can review and synthesize the evolution of Hungarian public law from customary constitution to the Alaptörvény.
I can accurately deploy normative and legal register structures (alapján, összhangban, jogosult/köteles, -andó/-endő).
I can write and converse authoritatively on constitutional history, judicial review, and rule-of-law principles in Hungarian.
